thread:
sophie.sales: FYI Northpoint wants a SOC2 excerpt + a signed pen-test attestation for POC. New twist: their auditors asked for either (A) ephemeral KMS keys we can mint for a 4-hour staging window or (B) a temporary SFTP user with one-time upload access. They also asked whether the attestation can be notarized. Can SE/security weigh in?
devin.se: Both options feasible. We can mint ephemeral KMS-wrapped keys for Private or provide a temp SFTP user that uploads to our secure bucket. Need to confirm outbound IP allowlist and whether they need an overnight window or daytime.
marc.sec: Security notes: (1) Pen-test attestation can be issued and we can add "notarized" if Legal signs off and we route to our corporate notary process; that will add ~2 business days. (2) Ephemeral KMS in Private requires KMS owner approval and a 1-page ops runbook. (3) SFTP user flow is acceptable but we must enforce single-use keys and short TTL, and rotate after upload.
sophie.sales: Timeline: customer wants artifacts within 72 hours. Is that realistic with notarization?
leah.pm: Notarization will push it out. If they accept unsigned attestation (signed by Legal) + a scanned signature instead of notarization we can hit 72h. I'll prepare the evidence bundle either way.
marc.sec: SOC2 will be redacted. Redaction rule: remove internal IPs, internal hostnames, and machine account emails. I'll drop the redaction checklist in the folder. compliance-bot: SOC2 redacted excerpt uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/soc2/northpoint-poc-2026-07-10.zip
devin.se: For ephemeral KMS example (API snippet):
```bash
# create a one-time data key (CMK must be pre-approved for POC)
aws kms generate-data-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > encrypted_key.bin
# provide encrypted_key.bin to auditor, lifetime 4h
```
Or we can spin up a temporary SFTP user: create user, restrict to /proof-upload/, expire in 6h.
sophie.sales: Customer says SFTP is preferred (their auditors can't use S3 tooling). Can infra stand up a temp SFTP user?
devin.se: Yes, but we need CIDR allowlist and the exact time window. Also we'll include server-side logging and emit a single-use upload token. Example server command to create expiring user is in our runbook.
marc.sec: Security constraints: single-use credential, TTL <=6h, server logs must include request_id and uploader IP. We also require MD5 checksum of the upload in the evidence manifest.
leah.pm: Pricing: if they require Dedicated single-tenant KMS or Dedicated SFTP nodes we need to add a line item for Dedicated isolation. Estimated delta: +$3,900/month for Dedicated+isolation (TBD after infra sizing). I'll add a one-time ephemeral setup fee of $1,200 for custom SFTP provisioning and notary handling.
sophie.sales: Noted. I'll surface the costs. Also they asked if the pen-test attestation can explicitly state we support on-prem HSMs. Safe to put this in the letter?
marc.sec: Allowed wording: "Redwood supports Private deployments with customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations." Do not assert specific HSM vendor support. Legal will review final phrasing.
leah.pm: Evidence checklist I'm assembling: 1) SOC2 redacted excerpt 2) minimal network diagram 3) pen-test attestation draft (notarized option flagged) 4) KMS keyflow + ephemeral runbook 5) SFTP provisioning instructions and presigned example 6) upload manifest template + MD5 checklist
sophie.sales: Presign/SFTP snippet to show their infra team?
devin.se: SFTP example in runbook:
```bash
# create temp user and set expiry (internal tool)
redwood-sftp create-user --username northpoint-audit --path /proof-upload --expires-in 21600 --single-use true
# we return host, username, and one-time password
```
For S3 presign alternative: ```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/northpoint-poc.zip --expires-in 14400
```
marc.sec: Security final notes: keep expiry short, single-use only, require request_id in logs, capture uploader IP and checksum, and redact any secrets from artifacts.
leah.pm: I'll upload the draft bundle and ping Legal for a quick review of notarization and HSM wording. compliance-bot: Pen-test-attestation-draft_vA.docx uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/templates/pen-test-attestation_northpoint_vA.docx
sophie.sales: Thanks team  Ill send to Northpoint, ask for CIDRs and exact staging window, and confirm whether notarization is required. Will update here if Legal or infra push back. :thumbsup:
